gloss: to penetrate; to pass through; to pierce

definitions.gloss: to penetrate; to pass through; to pierce
definitions.explanation: To pass completely through something from one side to the other. Used for physical objects, bullets, tunnels, and roads.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弾丸|だんがん}→弾丸：12502_dangan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貫通|かんつう}した。
⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貫通|かんつう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A tunnel passes through the mountain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{高速|こうそく}{道路|どうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{南北|なんぼく}→南北：04287_nanboku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貫通|かんつう}する⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A plan was announced for a new expressway to pass through the center of the city from north to south.

notes:
Describes something passing completely through an object or area from one side to the other. The key nuance is complete passage — not just entering but emerging on the other side.

USAGE:
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the thing passed through: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貫通|かんつう}する
- Can be transitive (a bullet penetrates a wall) or describe a route (a road passes through a region)
- Common in news reports, engineering, and military contexts

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{弾丸|だんがん}→弾丸：12502_dangan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{貫通|かんつう}する: a bullet penetrates
- ⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{貫通|かんつう}する: a tunnel breaks through
- ⟦{貫通|かんつう}→貫通：21354_kantsuu⟧{傷|しょう}: penetrating wound
- ⟦{貫通|かんつう}→貫通：21354_kantsuu⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: breakthrough construction (tunnel)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{突|つ}き{抜|ぬ}ける→突き抜ける：21651_tsukinukeru⟧: to break through, to pass through — more everyday; can also mean to be outstanding
- ⟦{突破|とっぱ}する→突破する：25363_toppasuru⟧: to break through — emphasizes overcoming resistance or barriers
- ⟦{浸透|しんとう}する→浸透する：22181_shintousuru⟧: to permeate, to infiltrate — gradual spreading through, not a single passage
